hints.title: Detecting Triple Consecutive Repetition
hints.text: A string is invalid if it contains three identical consecutive characters.

hints.title: Incremental Builder Validation
hints.text: Iterate through the string, appending each character only if the last two characters in the builder are not identical to it.

hints.title: Single Pass Construction
hints.text: Construct the output in a single linear pass and return the joined string.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Single pass builder checking trailing two characters.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Repeated string replacement or regex matching creates quadratic temporary string copies.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: List-based character accumulation runs in optimal linear time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should write clean, linear builder filtering.
